title: jtckdint: Add C23 compatible checked arithmetic header
description:
Add a header-only library for C23 checked integer arithmetic from
https://github.com/jart/jtckdint

This header is not used on this branch yet, but makes it easier
to backport fixes from the latest development.

Ping #20144

(backported from commit 9883652f9657e8bd8f32a8e0a16e2f1a2434969e)

notes.body: Do you have any specific backports in mind, because 4.2 is about to be retired (when 4.6 becomes the new stable release) so this will be of no use?
It depends on if any errors found by fuzz testing (e.g., of wiretap) end up being backported. It may not be worth bothering.
Oth it's not big deal including it even if it never gets used.
I guess this is obsolete now.

commits_data.title: jtckdint: Cast to prevent MSVC (C4244) shortening errors
commits_data.message:
jtckdint: Cast to prevent MSVC (C4244) shortening errors

Explicitly cast the result to prevent MSVC from warning about
possible shortening from implicit casts.

(cherry picked from commit e466733077428d19dd4d4a52c31f35e634775eab)
